purpose: Resolve the user's request to check whether Yao consolidation requires the same mixed side/bottom slip as Lian before future tests and formal delivery
scope: Primary-paper and current-configuration/source audit only; no solver started and no physical settings changed

reference.paper: C. Yao et al., 2-D SPH modelling of poroelasticity: u-w-p and u-p formulations, Computers and Geotechnics179(2025)107016
reference.PDF: src/papers/PDF/2D SPH modelling of poroelasticity u-w-p and u-p formulations.pdf
reference.rendered_local_pages: tests/outputs/yao_boundary_ref_r1/page_21.png through page_24.png; PyMuPDF rendering used because Poppler is unavailable

consolidation_section_5_2_3.geometry: 20m x10m plane-strain layer, frictionless6m strip, ramp0.1s to5kPa

side_Gamma3.mechanical: free-slip: ux=0 and effective shear sigma_xz=0

bottom_Gamma4.mechanical: free-slip: uz=0 and effective shear sigma_xz=0; ux is not fixed

consolidation_section_5_2_3.symmetry_Gamma5: ux=0, effective shear sigma_xz=0 and zero normal flow; current full-width model has no internal symmetry wall
consolidation_section_5_2_3.evidence: Opening paragraph on page21, explicit Gamma3/Gamma4 conditions on page22 and roller symbols in Fig26 agree on free-slip bottom
consolidation_section_5_2_3.ambiguity: Absorbing-boundary discussion on page24 calls the original bottom no-slip. This conflicts with the opening and explicit boundary equations; author intent is not independently resolved here.
consolidation_section_5_2_3.decision: Retain side/bottom free-slip as the principal rigid-boundary reproduction. Do not claim the isolated contradictory wording proves a no-slip consolidation bottom.

other_problem.differences: 21m width,1m stress pulse footprint, pulse over0.04s and100kPa amplitude
other_problem.warning: Do not transfer this mixed-slip definition to the Section5.2.3 consolidation without changing the problem label. Lian's own mixed-slip definition remains unchanged.

current_inputs.root_default: CaseYao2DConsolidation_PR_Def.xml: global SlipMode3, no per-mk override
current_inputs.root_SPR: CaseYao2DConsolidation_PR_SPR_Def.xml: mk0 bottom, mk1 left, mk2 right, separate planar normals; all use global SlipMode3
current_inputs.existing_results: Retained10s SPR off/on/half results are all-free-slip. Do not relabel or overwrite them as mixed-slip validation.

code_limit.restriction: Current SPR explicitly rejects MdbcSlipModeByMk. General mDBC already supports per-mk slip, but that is not proof of mixed-slip SPR support.
code_limit.next_if_mixed_slip_needed: First test mixed mDBC with SPRoff; then implement and validate per-face corner/ghost consistency on CPU/GPU before enabling SPR. Do not bypass the guard.

future_delivery: List each face's mechanical and hydraulic conditions explicitly in new tests/formal input comments
Keep boundary sensitivity separate from SPR, hourglass, damping or loading changes
If a bottom-no-slip comparison is justified, use an independent test tag and compare pressure, settlement, horizontal displacement and bottom shear before choosing any formal variant
Only after necessary acceptance update root formal XML/BAT, execute full real-program runs and publish matching figures/CSVs
Selectively verify and back up this decision and later validated changes to local/remote Git
Lian_drained_sequence: Existing fresh3s GPU coarse/half continuation remains untouched; no duplicate solver or watcher was launched
